conviction_note: Q1 (July-September) is KWS's seasonally smallest, loss-making quarter (last year 228.2m of ~1.63bn sales), nothing has been pre-released (no ad-hoc since 2025-09-24), the FY26/27 guide was reset below consensus on 2026-09-23 (stock -9.0% that day) and every recent Q1 statement simply confirmed the guide, so I expect a reiteration day: abs_move 3.5 (own Q1 print days +2.81 / -2.82 / -3.90, lifted for the name's large print-day tail and the conditional guide), p_up 46 because the findings nearly offset (a mechanical headline EBITDA drop from lapping a ~30m one-off and a drier French rapeseed sowing season against a low sugar-beet base and a stock that has already de-rated) and the name's print days have mostly been sold; findings sum -0.15 against a scaled -0.28, same sign, both small.

Prior-year Q1 2025/26 comparison base: sales 228.2m, EBITDA 4.8m including a ~30m one-off from the sale of licensing rights (North American corn divestiture), sugar beet Q1 sales 34.3m (56.9m) after prior-year early sales in Eastern Europe, cereals 172.1m with rapeseed +19%
No Q1 pre-release: the last KWS ad-hoc on EQS-News is 2025-09-24 (dividend policy); items since 2026-09-23 are only the AGM convocation (23 Oct 2026)

new_in_release.expect: Q1 2026/27 sales and EBITDA, first look at the new year; reported EBITDA mechanically lower year on year because the ~30m licensing one-off does not repeat; cereals (rapeseed) likely flat-to-weaker on a high +19% comp and a smaller French sowing area, sugar beet on a low base. Net: unknown, slight negative lean on the headline.

most likely reiterated (all of the last three Q1 statements 'bestaetigt'); small risk of a qualification given the guide is explicitly conditional on market recovery. Direction if changed: down more likely than up.
Q1 free cash flow is seasonally negative (-50.6m last year, flattered by a divestiture instalment); unknown.
no change; 1.30 EUR already proposed for the 1 Dec 2026 AGM.

A quarterly bar is therefore unsourced and every quarter-dependent finding is capped small.

findings.finding: Q1 2026/27 laps a ~EUR 30m one-off: last year's Q1 EBITDA of EUR 4.8m (vs -10.0m) included about EUR 30m from selling licensing rights in the North American corn divestiture, plus a EUR 7.7m AgReliant disposal gain in the financial result, so reported Q1 EBITDA and EPS will fall sharply year on year (to roughly the -20s on an unchanged underlying business) and the dpa-AFX headline will read as a deterioration.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2025-11-12 the same one-off flattered Q1 into positive EBITDA and the stock rose 2.81% (dpa-AFX: 'Verlust sinkt dank Spartenverkauf'); the earlier Q1 days without it fell 2.82% (2024-11-13) and 3.90% (2023-11-09).
findings.original_quote: Im Berichtszeitraum enthielten diese einen positiven Sondereffekt aus der Veräußerung von Lizenzrechten im Rahmen des Verkaufs des nordamerikanischen Maisgeschäftes von ca. 30 Mio. €. Das Ergebnis vor Zinsen, Steuern und Abschreibungen (EBITDA) verbesserte sich auf 4,8 (–10,0) Mio. €. | In the reporting period these included a positive one-off of about EUR 30m from the sale of licensing rights in the sale of the North American corn business. EBITDA improved to EUR 4.8 (-10.0)m.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the one-off was disclosed a year ago and restated in the FY release ('positiver Sondereffekt von 29,0 Mio. €'), and analysts model it out. The residual is the headline effect on a thinly traded SDAX name ($0.7m/day) where a 'KWS Saat mit Ergebnisrückgang' wire headline at 07:00 can move the open; if it were fully discounted the stock would not have moved 2.8% on the same quarter's flattered headline last year.
findings.independence: The FY 2025/26 release restates the one-off at 29.0m: https://www.eqs-news.com/de/news/corporate/stabile-geschaeftsentwicklung-in-herausforderndem-marktumfeld-kws-veroeffentlicht-ergebnisse-fuer-das-geschaeftsjahr-2025-2026/eee7086a-c2df-481e-8d76-fb49b0240635_de -- same issuer, so not independent of the fact, only of the date.

findings.finding: The autumn-2026 rapeseed sowing season, which drives KWS's Q1 cereals segment (172.1m of 228.2m Q1 sales last year, rapeseed +19%), was hit by drought: market reporting of 28-29 Sept 2026 expects the EU rapeseed area for harvest 2027 down about 2% (6.4m to 6.3m ha), with France, the EU's largest producer, down 10-15% because the soil was too dry to sow; Germany and Poland had so far lost yield rather than area.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cereals/rapeseed was the positive line in Q1 2025/26 (+19% rapeseed, segment EBITDA 77.9m vs 74.5m) on a +2.81% day; no observed Q1 where it disappointed.
findings.original_quote: Frankreich, der größte Produzent der EU, steht vor dem stärksten Rückgang ... In Frankreich haben schwere Bodenfeuchtigkeitsdefizite die Aussaat bereits eingeschränkt ... In Deutschland und Polen äußerte sich die Dürre bislang hauptsächlich in Ertragskürzungen und weniger in einem Ausfall der Aussaat. | France, the EU's largest producer, faces the steepest decline ... severe soil-moisture deficits have already limited sowing ... In Germany and Poland the drought has so far shown mainly in yield cuts rather than in failed sowing.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a market-commentary proxy, not a company number, and KWS's rapeseed share gains (it called rapeseed its strongest cereals crop with a leading position in Europe in the FY release) can offset a smaller market; a 2% EU area decline is small. If the market had priced a weak Q1 cereals line the stock would be drifting lower into the print; instead it is +2.4% over five sessions.
findings.independence: Same desk, next day, same numbers: https://commodity-board.com/eu-raps-unter-druck-franzoesische-anbauflaeche-schrumpft-und-logistik-wird-schwieriger (2026-09-29). Not independent. A UFOP release of July 2026 had rather called rapeseed sowing for 2027 economically attractive (https://www.ufop.de/index.php/download_file/view/14998/698/), which cuts the other way on intent if not on weather.

findings.finding: Sugar beet starts Q1 2026/27 from a low base: last year's Q1 sugar-beet sales fell to EUR 34.3m from 56.9m and segment EBITDA to -30.5m from -8.3m because the year before had pulled early sales forward in Eastern Europe, so any normal timing of Eastern European early orders this year shows as growth.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The sugar-beet Q1 drop last year was absorbed on a +2.81% day because the one-off dominated; the segment's Q1 has not been the line the stock traded on.
findings.original_quote: Der deutliche Umsatzrückgang im Berichtsquartal auf 34,3 (56,9) Mio. € ist im Wesentlichen verursacht durch starke Frühverkäufe im Vorjahreszeitraum in Osteuropa. | The marked sales decline in the quarter to EUR 34.3 (56.9)m is mainly due to strong early sales in Eastern Europe in the prior-year period.
findings.why_not_priced: An inference from timing: nothing says early orders recurred this year, and the low EU sugar price and Südzucker's area cuts argue against generous early buying; it matters only because Q1 is small, so a 10-20m swing in beet sales is visible in group Q1 growth. Shares the Q1 2025/26 release with finding 1 but rests on a different line of it.

findings.finding: The guide reset and de-rating already happened: on 2026-09-23 KWS guided FY26/27 below consensus (organic ~3%, margin 19-20% vs the 19-21% medium-term band) and the stock fell 9.0% (Börsen-Zeitung: down as much as 11.5% intraday; revenue and EBITDA had missed consensus); since then it has sat at EUR 66-68 with no further news, and DZ Bank upgraded it to 'Kaufen' (fair value 82) on 20 Oct 2026 without a price response -- so a Q1 that merely confirms the guide is landing on a reset bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Every recent Q1 statement confirmed the guide ('bestätigt Prognosen', 12.11.2025) and Q1 days moved +2.81 / -2.82 / -3.90; the stock's large moves have come on guide changes (-7.42% on 2026-02-12, -9.03% on 2026-09-23), and seven of the last eight print days closed lower.
findings.original_quote: Umsatz und Ebitda verfehlten die durchschnittlichen Analystenerwartungen. ... gab nach der Bilanzvorlage aber um bis zu 11,5% auf 69,60 Euro nach. | Sales and EBITDA missed average analyst expectations ... fell as much as 11.5% to EUR 69.60 after the results.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced by construction (the reset is the price). What is not in the price is a disappointment-free confirmation, given the guide is explicitly conditional on market recovery; if holders expected a second cut the stock would have drifted below the post-results level rather than holding 66-68 and rising 2.4% over five sessions. Inference, so small.
findings.independence: DZ Bank upgrade, dpa-AFX 20.10.2026: https://www.boerse-online.de/dpa-afx/analyse-flash-dz-bank-hebt-kws-saat-auf-kaufen-und-fairen-wert-auf-82-euro-559467.html ('von "Halten" auf "Kaufen" hochgestuft'); tape from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/KWS.DE?range=5y&interval=1d.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is flat (-0.015, effectively the run-up) and the 5-day run-up is +2.4%; my findings nearly offset and lean very slightly negative on the headline, so they neither agree with nor beat anything the baseline holds -- this is close to a non-result.
language_note: All primary company documents (Q1 2025/26 and FY 2025/26 releases) exist in both languages on EQS; the German versions were used for quotes and carried nothing the English did not.
The drought-hit autumn rapeseed sowing proxy (EU -2%, France -10-15%) came from German-language commodity reporting (commodity-board.com, 28-29 Sept 2026); not found in the English sources searched.
The dpa-AFX German broker feed was what confirmed the DZ Bank upgrade of 20.10.2026 and showed that the Baader/Kepler October items circulating on an aggregator have no wire record.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the one-off lap (finding 1) was disclosed a year ago and restated in September, cut from -0.3 to -0.15.
'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series' / macro-to-company is a hypothesis: rapeseed area proxy cut from -0.5 to -0.4 and the sugar-beet base inference from +0.2 to +0.15.
'Positioning is the thing to beat' and anchor_covered false: the de-rating finding trimmed from +0.3 to +0.25.

'You were right about the number and too small about the move' / understatement: abs_move_pct raised from 3.0 to 3.5 (KWS print days have a fat tail and the guide is conditional), while 'beats have been sold here' moved p_up from 47 to 46 rather than shrinking the size.
